name: AC induction motors
summary: Mains-powered induction motors: tough brushless motors in pumps, fans, washers and compressors.
uses: Running pumps, saws, grinders and fans from a generator or inverter
Spare motor for a well or pool pump
identify: Heavy steel-cased motors with a nameplate giving volts, amps, rpm and hp, often with a capacitor attached. In older top-loading washers, furnace blowers, pool and well pumps, bench grinders, table saws and compressors.
test: Discharge any attached capacitor first. The windings should read a few ohms between leads and open to the case, and the shaft should spin freely with no grinding.
